notes: συνηκολούθει αὐτῷ -> 'followed with him' gave 'with' to the verb as its σύν- element. Rules 21 and 36, rule 69's κατα-compound precedent, and the chapter's own 14.5, 14.46, 14.53 and 14.65 all put such a preposition on the governed dative. Moved 'with' to αὐτῷ; the accusative αὐτόν later in the verse keeps its verb's particle 'on' unchanged, which is the in-verse control.
